node.title: Affine low-pair carriers bound original defect mass after auxiliary core cancellation
node.statement: For distinct original scalar-agreement labels with size-m supports, chosen pairs in (a0+U)x(b0+U), dimU=s>=1, degU<K, m=K+d, and defects1<=tau<=T<=d, let Z={U(x)=0,u=a0,v=b0},z=|Z|. Then z<=K-s and sum tau<=floor((n-z)_(s+1)/((s+1)*(m-z-T)*product_(j=1)^(s-1)(d-T+j))). Original supports need not contain Z; all defects and labels survive auxiliary translation/cancellation. No auxiliary minimality, error-rank or HIGH hypothesis. Weighted tuple ownership, not a pair census or Prize bound.
